name: Decker
description: The free world is in danger, and only one man can help. Jack Decker has sworn to defend America from foreign terrorists regardless of which spineless president is in charge. This is Decker: The Series.

credits_cast.character: Abdul / Wolfman / Frankenstein / Bob Cratchit / Jacob Marley / Mummy / Charlie Chaplin / W-CPO
credits_cast.name: Mark Proksch

credits_cast.character: Agent Jack Decker / Agent Jack Decker Jr.
credits_cast.name: Tim Heidecker

videos.title: Decker Versus Dracula: The Lost Works
videos.overview: Writer/director Gregg Turkington weighs in on the aborted Decker Vs. Dracula! Also, find out what YOU can do to help!

videos.title: Decker Vs. Dracula: Behind The Truth
videos.overview: Decker creator and star, Tim Heidecker, sheds light on the troubled production, Decker Vs. Dracula. (A Heidecker Doc Production.)

videos.title: The Animated Adventures of Jack Decker
videos.overview: Decker saves corn culture from a plot concocted by Dracula and Rumpelstilskin

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Special Agent Jack Decker takes on terror threats in Afghanistan.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After making his way to the Oval Office, Decker tells the president the facts about the terrorist nuclear threat.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: With an explosive suitcase, Decker struggles to get answers from the president's code expert.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The suitcase has been opened and the nuclear threat analyzed; now, Decker must travel to New York City to thwart the plot.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Decker returns to the White House to inform President Davidson of his recent actions in New York City.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Decker relaxes in Hawaii, unbeknownst to him that terrorists are plotting a major attack.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Decker reconnects with his oldest and dearest friend, Lanoi Arnold. As celebration, he performs his hit song.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The future of Decker's vacation is placed in peril. Will he shun responsibility, or will he step up to the challenge?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Decker learns a fellow patriot might not be all that he seems. He goes on the hunt, ready for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Decker tracks down Agent Kington and learns a deeply hidden secret.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With time running out for the president, Decker comes up with an ingenious plan to gain new intel.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Decker takes to the water on a specially built jet ski. Meanwhile, Kington acquires a tape from a suspicious source.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Lanoi reveals new concerns about Decker to Special Agent Kington.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Decker and Kington decide the only way forward is through jungle warfare.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Decker declares the time for strategy is over. They must take action or the island, and America, will be lost.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Decker and Kington infiltrate the terrorists' secret compound. A disgraced President Davidson looks back on his legacy.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: With Hawaii on the brink of destruction, President Davidson calls Decker for the latest intel.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Decker attempts a risky plan that, if completed, will gain him access to the location of every terrorist on the island.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: With Decker's guidance, Kington learns the true meaning of why good men fight.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Decker nears the terrorists' location on the old abandoned CIA zipline.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: With Decker in the field, President Davidson calls Kington for the latest updates.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Decker continues his jungle assault only to come across a massive breach in security.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Trapped in a terrorist hideout with no options, Decker turns to Kington in a last ditch effort for freedom.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Decker uses his CIA training to gain hard-hitting intel.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: In order to save the nation, Decker must come face-to-face with pure evil.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Decker is faced with the biggest threat this world has ever known: Dracula is teaming up with a handful of evil monsters.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Special Agent Kington embarks to Transylvania, where he must face a horrifying trio.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When President Davidson heads to Transylvania, Decker must assume the most powerful position in the free world.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Buckling to pressure, Decker makes a fateful decision.

videos.title: All Good Things...
videos.overview: Special Agent Jack Decker finds himself in a treacherous situation with no one but master codebreaker Jonathan Kington to help. Working together, they must stop a horrible evil and its sinister plans.

videos.title: The New Recruits
videos.overview: Young recruit Jack Decker rallies against the pc-culture around him to save hundreds of innocent heroes.

videos.title: The Butterfly Effect
videos.overview: Decker goes back in time to stop one of the largest attacks against America. Will he succeed, or will he alter the course of human history forever?

videos.title: Global Hoax
videos.overview: With an energy crisis plaguing America, Jack Decker and Agent Kington discover a powerful organization at the root of it all.

videos.title: Band Together
videos.overview: Supergroup "Dekkar" infiltrates the world's most powerful terrorist group. In the process, Decker learns the true meaning of friendship from one of his closest allies.

videos.title: A New Hero
videos.overview: With nowhere to turn and danger looming, Agent Jonathan Kington finds a new champion of American freedom - now he just has to convince him to join the team.

videos.title: Sonrise
videos.overview: Decker and Kington race against the clock to prevent a massive attack that threatens the entire male gender.

videos.title: Promises Kept
videos.overview: Decker's vacation in Hawaii is interrupted by breaking news.

videos.title: Double Decker
videos.overview: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, Decker has forty-eight hours to clear his name.

videos.title: Private Sector
videos.overview: While on the job for his famous security business, Decker becomes close with a top client.

videos.title: Same Old Glory
videos.overview: Decker Jr. and others learn the importance of the stars and stripes through the power of the movies.

videos.title: A Grave Matter
videos.overview: In the season finale, Decker Jr. and his friends visit his father's burial site. Meanwhile, a powerful enemy prepares for his revenge.

videos.title: Lesser of Two Evils
videos.overview: In the season premiere, a traumatic experience leaves Decker in rough shape. Davidson recounts a time when Decker helped him win a presidential election.

videos.title: Trouble on the Bayou
videos.overview: Decker is visited by his oldest friend Lanoi, who tells the story of a much needed vacation in New Orleans.

videos.title: DavidsonCare
videos.overview: After a fellow veteran is murdered, Decker's search for the truth leads him to take on the healthcare system.

videos.title: Desert Caravan
videos.overview: Decker in the desert as he finds another agent after his own heart, and an emergency surgery for Kington.

videos.title: Rock and a Hard Place
videos.overview: Decker gets some much-needed time off only to find he is needed to help the passengers of a hijacked Film Buff cruise ship.

videos.title: Space Wall
videos.overview: President Decker Jr. and his subordinate Kington go on an other worldly mission in the season finale.
